records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
records.summary: Personally designed and built an internal dispatch reconciliation tool using a Python parser and SQL checks. It helped operators compare an overnight spreadsheet with a daily export and see understandable exceptions. The team reduced reconciliation time; the result was not solely attributable to Ada. It was operationally used, not a product sold to external customers.

decisions.reason: The profile and its claims are supported by the source.
The role, dates, contributions, tools, and stated limits of responsibility are supported.
The summary says the tool let operators see understandable exceptions, but the source says only that supervisors wanted understandable exceptions; it does not establish that this was delivered.
The source supports the training count, two workshops, handbook, and absence of exact workshop dates.
The source supports the communication work, but it names only Git and coworker training under the Collaboration skill category; it does not assign stakeholder communication to that category.
